I am a Consultant Transplant Surgeon at the **Cardiff Transplant Unit**, specialising in kidney and pancreas transplantation, organ retrieval, organ utilisation, and perioperative outcomes.

My work spans surgery, data, and policy. I focus on improving access to transplantation and optimising post-transplant care, collaborating with national programmes on organ utilisation policy and contributing to multicentre clinical studies.

## Research Interests

::: {.research-pills}
[Kidney and pancreas transplantation outcomes]{.pill}
[Organ preservation and machine perfusion]{.pill}
[Donor risk stratification and organ utilisation]{.pill}
[Vascular access for haemodialysis]{.pill}
[Data science applied to transplant decision-making]{.pill}
:::

## Current Work

::: {.highlight-block}
I played a central role in establishing the **Normothermic Regional Perfusion (NRP) programme** at Cardiff and in training our team — improving organ quality assessment and expanding the use of DCD donor organs for transplantation.

I apply R and data science methods to clinical transplant questions, from survival modelling and risk prediction to making better use of national organ offering data. I am also a keen advocate for AI in medicine, and use **Claude** extensively across my research and analytical workflows.
:::
